name: daily-block-daily-spacing-intermediate-reversion
rationale: Mandatory cost hypothesis (13th consecutive negative benchmark run). On 2026-10-04 the block/spacing curve at 500,000 JPY was still improving at 8h/8h (Sharpe +4.48, sharpe_minus_static_mix -0.58, fees 1,873 JPY vs 28,874 baseline), after 4h/4h + rsi60/bb90 (+3.70) and 2h/2h + rsi60/bb90 (+5.99 on 2026-10-01's window). The Ekren/Liu/Muhle-Karbe result cited on 2026-10-04 predicts an interior optimum; one rebalance per UTC day is the natural next dose and tests whether the curve turns over or crosses static. Expect very few trades, so the trade-count criterion will likely refuse it; the value is in locating the optimum for the pending human decision on that criterion.
